payload.title: Paleoclimate Model Data-Comparison: CMIP6 vs LMR
payload.summary: This Jupyter notebook compares climate model outputs from CMIP6 with reconstructions from the Last Millennium Reanalysis (LMR) project. It demonstrates how to access and process CMIP6 data from Google Cloud, plot LMR simulations alongside CMIP6 outputs, and visualize spatial variations in climate data. The notebook focuses on analyzing global-mean surface temperature and the climate response to major volcanic events over the past millennium.
goals: Compare CMIP6 model outputs with LMR reconstructions.
Visualize climate responses to volcanic events.
Demonstrate data access and processing techniques for CMIP6 data.
